height 3.38 studs | 30 blocks | 548 triangles | bevel 0.1 x 2 | 1 stud = 67 px
Concept sheet drawn from the spec note's parts table (tools/blocky/sheet.py); blocky style rules: Blocky-Style.md
Parts (the note's table; mirror x makes an R and an L)
Face plate: `bubble` (Rare eye), 28 x 12 px at 16 a stud, 5 frames
Silhouettes at 64 px (black shape, each view in its own frame)
Element: Lightning. VFX: a soft light (Rare), three layers in Effects.luau: a pale blue static
beam flickers over the crest (Top to Back, six segments), a soft blue light pulses at the
crest, and two pale sparks pop off the crest every 1.2 s; the game's own idle flaps the wings
15 degrees. The flourish (every 7 s) is a jolt: a hop with the wings flared, the zigzag
antennae whipping, the tail fanning and a squash on landing
